brief.product: Native macOS git diff viewer in Rust and Rune
brief.action: Inspect changes and select files, hunks, lines or words for a commit
brief.surfaces: macOS app icon, repository and future website
brief.assets: Dark graphite icon, red/green diff bars; existing sculpted C concept
brief.meaning: Collate: collect and arrange; compare critically
brief.reference: User-supplied dark macOS Dock with crisp white symbols, saturated colour accents and restrained tile depth
brief.latest_request: User likes Split C and requests more variants, better sharpness, taste, shadows and finish.

assumptions: Primary surface is the macOS app; web lockup is secondary

ideas.name: Selected C
ideas.sentence: Separate one segment from a substantial C to picture selecting a word-sized change while keeping its context.

ideas.name: Aligned halves
ideas.sentence: Two aligned open rails stand for before and after brought together in a single review.

ideas.name: Paired letters
ideas.sentence: Align and join the two l stems in Collate to turn the name into two compared columns.

ideas.name: Chosen hunk
ideas.sentence: Gather three offset code lines against one common edge, turning loose edits into a commit.

ideas.name: Split C
ideas.sentence: Two aligned angular halves turn the before-and-after comparison into one C, with a visible seam between them.

rounds.tried: Five concepts across four ideas, including the lettering-led option
rounds.wrong: Selected C has a stray upper-right tooth and a slit too fine at 16px. Hunk reads E. Pages resembles a copy command. Joined ll can read U. Rails are clear but generic.
rounds.changed: Remove the tooth, widen the separation, and increase the C weight for round two.

rounds.tried: Heavier selected C in colour and monochrome
rounds.wrong: An inner-corner sliver survives below the selected bar. The gap is still soft at 16px, and the mark needs more visual weight.
rounds.changed: Cut through the entire inner corner; use 144-unit weight and 56-unit separation, and reduce small-icon corner rounding.

rounds.tried: 144-unit C, 56-unit gap, simplified small cap, light and reversed variants, lockup
rounds.wrong: At 16px the separating gap is subpixel and softer than at 29px; the ll ligature loses clarity at small width.
rounds.changed: Use the plainer cap for tiny icons, retain an unmodified readable wordmark, and set recommended lockup minimum to 120px. Accept that the C silhouette, rather than the selection metaphor, leads at 16px.

rounds.tried: Angular split C, blue split C, angular selected C and diagonal comparison glyph
rounds.wrong: The 88-unit rails look thin beside the Dock references. The diagonal glyph reads as fragments; the selected C retains too much of the rejected direction.
rounds.changed: Choose the split C; thicken rails to 112 and increase seam to 64.

rounds.tried: 112-unit split C in white and blue/white
rounds.wrong: The seam still partly closes at 16px. Two-tone halves overemphasize status colour.
rounds.changed: Widen seam to 80 and prefer an entirely white mark. Keep a single-blue alternative.

rounds.tried: Final 80-unit seam, monochrome figure, blue alternative and light/dark wordmarks
rounds.wrong: The C is legible at 16px but its seam remains subtler there than at Dock sizes. The 80px lockup is too small for the name.
rounds.changed: Use the standalone symbol for tiny sizes; set lockup minimum at 120px. Keep depth in the tile only, leaving a flat monochrome master.

rounds.tried: Six finishes: Precision, Machined, Graphite, Cobalt, Glacier and Porcelain
rounds.wrong: Deep extrusion creates heavy undersides. Broad shadows soften edges. Graphite has weak small-size contrast.
rounds.changed: Reduce extrusion and shadow spread; compare two additional silhouette options, Compact and Blade.

rounds.tried: Reduced-depth finishes plus Compact and Blade silhouettes
rounds.wrong: Graphite still loses contrast. Blade’s long chamfer intersects the seam and makes a small tooth. Metal highlights are too thick.
rounds.changed: Brighten Graphite, shorten Blade’s chamfer, reduce the highlight to three units, and add a flat pixel-aligned small-size version.

rounds.tried: Eight refined variants and a pixel-aligned flat small-size mark
rounds.wrong: Strong effects become indistinguishable at favicon size. Compact reads more like a bracket; Blade is more delicate.
rounds.changed: Recommend Machined as the balanced finish, retain Compact as the geometric alternative, and provide a separate flat small-size treatment instead of relying on relief at 16px.

rounds.tried: Apply the preferred Compact C to all four retained finishes
rounds.wrong: Graphite, Porcelain and Cobalt had thinner, wider geometry than the preferred Compact.
rounds.changed: Share Compact geometry: 128-unit rails, 80-unit seam, 130-unit chamfer, left 264, right 760, top 248. Preserve finish colours and lighting.

chosen: Compact C geometry in Graphite, Compact, Porcelain and Cobalt
status: Approved four-finish Compact C family; rejected artwork and stale reviews removed

checks.visual: Eight-variant review page inspected at 1280px and 400px in light and dark, all 20 screenshot slices. Interactive gallery previewed at 728px dark and 390px light with no console errors; selection behavior checked for all eight variants.
